# Kraken.io

Kraken.io is an image optimization and compression platform that helps reduce image file sizes without compromising quality.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/kraken-io/.

## Actions

- **Check Kraken.io User Status** (read-only): Retrieve current kraken.io account status and quota usage.
- **Optimize Image by URL**: Optimize an image from a public url.
- **Preserve Image Metadata**: Preserve exif and other metadata during kraken.io image optimization.
- **Sandbox Image Upload**: Upload and optimize images in sandbox mode.
